critical_findings.title: All 52 expected secrets are template-only
critical_findings.description: The .env file is a verbatim copy of .env.example (52 lines, all template values). 0 of 52 expected environment variables have actual secret values. This blocks ALL runtime verification: no Vercel API access, no Inngest event enqueue, no Turso connection, no Neon connection, no S3 archive writes, no AI Gateway invocations, no NextAuth sessions.
critical_findings.impact: No runtime can be exercised. No end-to-end stack test. No Pilot A. No evidence chain. No KPI measurements. No replays. Production deployment is BLOCKED.
critical_findings.recovery: Operator must provision actual secrets in .env. NOT automatable — secrets must be supplied by operator from each provider's dashboard/CLI. After provisioning: re-run P76 audit to upgrade runtime-related findings from BLOCKED to VERIFIED.
critical_findings.introduced_by_p75_note: P75 created the .env template (cp .env.example .env) — this is the correct action when actual secrets are not available. P75 did NOT cause this finding; it documented it as PARTIALLY_CLOSED (LD-18). The finding persists in P76 because operator has not yet provisioned actual secrets.
